verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents its own API reference at api.playcanvas.com/editor/, describing a comprehensive Editor API. Separately, create-playcanvas offers 12 runnable starters. Neither item shows the reference itself is interactive or embeds runnable examples, and the starters are project scaffolds rather than in-reference examples. missing for 10: evidence that the API reference is interactive, runnable examples embedded in or linked from API entries, engine API reference coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Editor module provides a comprehensive API for automating and extending the functionality of the PlayCanvas Editor.
Use `create-playcanvas` to scaffold a Vite and TypeScript project for the Engine, React, or Web Components from one of 12 runnable starters.
